name: Town house (narrow, three-storey, flat roof)
style: low-poly, flat colours (Quaternius Ultimate Building Pack, 'Models with Materials')

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 152 named a Quaternius static town house on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is 3Story_Balcony_Mat from the same Ultimate Textured Building Pack on OpenGameArt (CC0) as the house entry, flat-material variant ("Models with Materials"), so the two read as one street: a narrow three-storey town house with a flat roof behind a corniced parapet, stone plinth, a front door up a stoop and French doors with small balconies on the two upper floors, two windows per floor. Scaled to 10 m to the top of the roof vents: three storeys of ~3 m (string courses at 3 m and 6 m) plus a parapet to ~9.6 m; footprint 5.1 x 6.0 m; doors ~2.3 m. Front door faces +Z. Candidates rendered and rejected: 3Story_Slim_Mat (narrowest, 2.8 m, but no windows at all, reads as a tower), 2Story_Slim_Mat (no windows either), 2Story_Mat and 2Story_Balcony_Mat (two storeys, 7-8 m wide), 3Story_Small_Mat (three storeys, windows only, plainer). Walls are red with brown shade so a street can mix it with the cream house.
